The second corrected sentence conflates two error targets (sentences 2 and 3 in the original) and repeats information ('the missing baselines (A-DDIM, PNDM) and the datasets other than CIFAR-10') that was already stated in the prior corrected sentence, making the rationale redundant and somewhat incoherent.

The rationale could better preserve the original reasoning structure while cleanly correcting each error; the current edit merges and duplicates content across sentences in a way that reduces coherence.
